name: How long does it take to complete accessibility-minded bathroom modifications?

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to complete accessibility-minded bathroom modifications?

acceptedAnswer.text: The timeline for accessibility-minded bathroom modifications depends on the complexity and extent of the project. Minor adjustments like installing grab bars can be completed in a day or two. More extensive renovations, such as converting a tub to a curbless shower or a full bathroom overhaul, can take several weeks, including planning, material ordering, and construction. We provide an estimated timeline with your project proposal.
acceptedAnswer.description: Completion times vary from a few days for minor changes to several weeks for extensive renovations, depending on project scope.
